useCase: 检测Stable Diffusion、DALL-E和Midjourney等现代扩散AI模型生成的内容
mechanism:
The 检测 methodology:

1. **High-frequency residual extraction**: 提取 high-frequency residuals correlating with the iterative denoising process.

2. **Spatial auto相关性**: Diffusion models operate in compressed latent space, creating characteristic spatial 相关性 模式 when decoded to pixel space.

3. **Denoising 伪影 检测**: Step-by-step denoising leaves subtle but detectable traces, particularly in smooth 梯度 regions.

4. **Cross-attention 模式**: Text-to-image diffusion models use cross-attention mechanisms creating detectable spatial 连贯性 模式.
accuracy: 高 - 86-94%. Effectiveness varies by model version and generation parameters.
name: 扩散模型检测
parameters:
Analysis window: 64x64, Noise extraction: Wiener filter
Spatial 相关性: auto相关性 maps
Target models: Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1/XL, DALL-E 2/3, Midjourney v4/v5/v6
description: 检测 伪影 specific to diffusion-based AI models (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney) 通过分析 denoising step residuals and latent space 模式 unique to the iterative denoising generation process.

references.title: Corvi, R. et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
Ricker, J. et al. (2022). Towards the Detection of Diffusion Model Deepfakes.
Sha, Z. et al. (2023). DE-FAKE: Detection and Attribution. ACM CCS.
Wang, Z. et al. (2023). DIRE for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection. ICCV.

strengths:
• Specifically designed for modern diffusion models
• 检测 even high-quality diffusion outputs
• Works 跨 different diffusion architectures
• Effective with both text-to-image and image-to-image
limitations:
• Rapid model evolution requires frequent updates
• Img2img with high denoising strength is harder 以检测
• Very small generated regions may evade 检测
• Model fine-tuning can alter detectable 模式
